description: AGSC-01-26a as stated on 2026-09-24: a name that no shipped adapter and no installed plugin answers is AGSC-E203 — a value outside a closed operator list — and exit 1, for export --to and import --from alike. Derivation: --to and --from are known flags carrying a value the adapter set does not hold, exactly the case AGSC-00-23 and cli-0009 settle for a compose or steer target, so AGSC-09-08's exit-2 usage codes (AGSC-E001 for a verb, AGSC-E002 for a flag) do not apply; the fault is a finding, exit 1. Before this date one reference engine answered the same fault with three codes (AGSC-E001, AGSC-E002, AGSC-E203). The value nope is chosen so that no adapter of any distribution can carry it by accident.
